model_annotation: The plot illustrates the performance of two methods, 0-CoT and CoRe, in terms of "Missing Step" across four different stages or conditions, labeled 0 through 4 on the x-axis. The x-axis is linear, ranging from 0 to 4 with integer tick labels spaced at intervals of 1, and has no explicit units. The y-axis, labeled "Missing Step," is also linear, ranging from approximately 0.845 to 0.860, with tick labels at intervals of 0.001 (e.g., 0.845, 0.848, 0.850, etc.). The 0-CoT method is represented by a dashed blue line with circular markers, starting at a value of approximately 0.860 at x=0 and decreasing to approximately 0.845 at x=4. The CoRe method is shown as a solid orange line with triangular markers, beginning at approximately 0.860 at x=0 and decreasing to approximately 0.848 at x=4. Both lines show a consistent downward trend across the x-axis, with CoRe maintaining slightly higher values than 0-CoT at each point, particularly noticeable from x=2 onwards.
